outcome: amount of delivery hemorrhage and bleeding 24 hours after delivery
cohort: Patients delivering in five primary hospitals in Shaoguan, Guangdong, China, from 2017 to 2018.
finding: Adopting feedforward control management and constructing a control system effectively reduced the incidence of postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) in primary hospitals.
mod_finding: The incidence of PPH decreased in both natural delivery (0.47%) and cesarean section (0.37%).
